allow: PowerShell($envFile = "C:\\Users\\orbit\\Desktop\\SE\\meta-app\\.env.local"; $token = \(Get-Content $envFile | Where-Object { $_ -match "^DK_SE_READ_TOKEN=" } | Select-Object -First 1\) -replace "^DK_SE_READ_TOKEN=", "" -replace '"', "" -replace "'", ""; $headers = @{ Authorization = "Bearer $token" }; $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://orbitools.orbiters.co.kr/api/datakeeper/query/?table=content_posts&brand=grosmimi&limit=5" -Headers $headers; $rows = if \($r -is [array]\) { $r } else { $r.rows }; Write-Output "count: $\($rows.Count\)"; Write-Output "keys:"; if \($rows.Count -gt 0\) { $rows[0].PSObject.Properties.Name | ForEach-Object { Write-Output "  $_" } })

PowerShell($sheetUrl = "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1wkue4G7FP_fiVeqSmMp7Z6IsIMmvOIc93TBb0NwcAmU/export?format=csv&gid=386147805"; $csv = \(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $sheetUrl -UseBasicParsing\).Content; Write-Output "=== coni/nopi/ichikuru 검색 ==="; \($csv -split "`n"\) | Where-Object { $_ -match "coni|nopi|ichikuru" } | Select-Object -First 20 | ForEach-Object { Write-Output $_.Substring\(0, [Math]::Min\(250, $_.Length\)\) })

PowerShell($session = New-Object Microsoft.PowerShell.Commands.WebRequestSession; $body = @{ password = "1111"; next = "/" } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/login" -Method POST -Body $body -ContentType "application/json" -WebSession $session -UseBasicParsing | Out-Null; $h = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/influencers" -WebSession $session -TimeoutSec 240 -UseBasicParsing; $html = $h.Content; $wlBadges = \([regex]::Matches\($html, ">WL<"\)\).Count; Write-Output "WL 배지 count: $wlBadges"; $block = [regex]::Match\($html, '\(?s\)grid-cols-5.+?\(?=section|\)'\); $nums = [regex]::Matches\($block.Value, '>\(\\d+\)<\\/div>'\); $labels = @\("S","A","B","C","NA"\); for \($i = 0; $i -lt 5; $i++\) { Write-Output " $\($labels[$i]\): $\($nums[$i].Groups[1].Value\)" })

PowerShell($proc = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($proc\) { Stop-Process -Id $proc.OwningProcess -Force; Write-Output "killed PID $\($proc.OwningProcess\)"; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 } else { Write-Output "no listener on 3000" })
